design_brief.description: Parametric 2D cross-section for a 15x15 mm T-slot aluminium extrusion profile intended for lightweight structural framing. The profile includes a central round through-bore, a square inner chamber, four symmetric T-slots (one per side) with defined opening and internal channel widths, specified lip and spar thicknesses, and corner fillets. Intended to be linearly extruded to a user-defined length for compatibility with standard T-slot connectors/accessories.

prompt_enhancement.enhanced_prompt: A T-slot aluminium extrusion profile with a 15 mm by 15 mm cross-section, featuring a 3.3 mm round central through-bore, a 5.5 mm square inner chamber size, a 6.2 mm T-slot opening width, a 9.5 mm internal slot channel width, a 1 mm T-slot lip thickness, a 0.9 mm internal spar thickness, and a 0.5 mm corner fillet. The profile is designed for lightweight structural applications, offering compatibility with standard T-slot connectors and accessories.
notes: Added technical specification about the profile's application and compatibility with standard connectors.

sketch.prompt:
Draw a clean, minimalistic orthographic technical line sketch of the described object on a white background. Use thin black lines only — no shading, no color, no photorealism, no perspective distortion. Keep proportions realistic. Show the front or three-quarter view that most clearly reveals all canonical parts of the object. If helpful, label key dimensions in millimeters with small arrows, but keep labels sparse. The sketch should look like a designer's concept drawing, suitable as a reference for a parametric CAD model.

OBJECT: A T-slot aluminium extrusion profile with a 15 mm by 15 mm cross-section, featuring a 3.3 mm round central through-bore, a 5.5 mm square inner chamber size, a 6.2 mm T-slot opening width, a 9.5 mm internal slot channel width, a 1 mm T-slot lip thickness, a 0.9 mm internal spar thickness, and a 0.5 mm corner fillet. The profile is designed for lightweight structural applications, offering compatibility with standard T-slot connectors and accessories.
REQUIRED PARTS (must be visible in the sketch): extrusion_profile_cross_section, central_through_bore, inner_square_chamber, t_slots_x4, outer_perimeter_with_corner_fillets, extrusion, corner, box_corner_profile_section
PROPORTIONAL CONSTRAINTS — primary_dimension = 15mm (category: generic).
All other parts of the sketch must scale consistently with this total size — no exaggerated wheels, handles, or details.
APPROX DIMENSIONS: profile_size≈15.0mm, length≈100.0mm, center_bore_diameter≈3.3mm, inner_chamber_square≈5.5mm, t_slot_opening_width≈6.2mm, t_slot_internal_channel_width≈9.5mm
NOTE: Extrusion length is not specified by the request; default parameter set to 100 mm for modeling and can be adjusted. Slot depth/position along the face is implied by the given opening/channel widths and spar/lip thicknesses; ensure manufacturable continuous walls and symmetry while preserving all stated clear widths/thicknesses.

Keep the final image below 1024x1024, clean white background, no text outside the dimension labels, no watermark.
